name: Strahnbrad Mystery
summary: A singed note asks you to investigate strange activity around the old bellows in Strahnbrad. Report what you learn in Hillsbrad.

sections.title: The Singed Note
sections.body: A note found in Strahnbrad warns that the old bellows seem to move when no one watches. Its writer dismisses the tale as a ghost story, yet insists you uncover the truth before their return. They believe great power lies in Strahnbrad, and fire magic has burned away the rest of the message.

sections.title: Your Findings
sections.body: In Hillsbrad, the townsfolk hear your report about the old bellows in Strahnbrad. A fire elemental lived within them, though how it came to be there remains a mystery.

faq.q: What is strange about the old bellows?
faq.answer: A singed note claims the old bellows in Strahnbrad spring to life when no one is watching.
The note does not name its writer; it says they will return.

faq.q: What does the note say about Strahnbrad?
faq.answer: The writer believes great power lies in Strahnbrad.

faq.q: Where do I report what I find?
faq.answer: You are asked to report your findings in town in Hillsbrad.
